integrity: The proof replaces the source proof's Hölder geometric-series estimates by a Dini dyadic-tail estimate and checks both existence and uniqueness of local products. No numerical experiment is used.
scientific_limitations: Dini continuity is sufficient, not asserted necessary.
The theorem is proved for the full two-symbol shift with the Bowen--Walters suspension geometry used by the cited source.
Equivalent results under unindexed Walters or summable-variation terminology remain a residual literature risk.
title: Dini roofs retain local product structure for full-shift suspensions
